P0.description: Everything the 30-Jul first-pass sweep could NOT establish, in one list: 7 drops still unread, 4 banks with data defects found during verification, and 4 banks that are explicitly first-pass only. Compiled at operator request so the next session can act on it immediately.

The 16:25 post-close run has now been killed mid-flight three times (29-Jul, 31-Jul, and 03-Jul before them) by an external console-close. The task is registered 'Interactive only', so it opens a console window at 16:25 and anything that closes that window takes the whole chain with it — today it died at step 1 of 21 and the desk served this morning's numbers until 19:10.

GitHub Pages deployments have been timing out since 12:32 UTC, so the live desk froze on an old emit while publish_dashboards reported ALL GREEN — its verification cannot tell two same-dated emits apart, and the watchdog's self-heal re-publishes into the same jam

P1.description: Twelve hand-verified fib banks belong to tickers that are NOT in ALL_TICKERS, so the daily pull never fetches them and every consumer fell through to historical_ohlc.csv — a manually-refreshed cache whose newest bar was 2026-06-05. RAILTEL rendered at 317.55 against a true 284.50. Prices repaired today; the structural gap is an operator decision.

P1.ticker: IRCON · IRFC · JWL · TEXRAIL · TITAGARH (TCS is fine)
P1.description: Five of the six tickers banked from the 260801 drop are absent from ALL_TICKERS and have no daily_prices.csv row, so their hand-verified levels cannot be priced, cannot reach the radar, and cannot be re-verified against a live close. This is the same defect F260731-BANKUNPRICED closed for twelve names last week, arriving again through the front door: banking a read does not onboard a ticker.

Today's 17:31 scheduled system_doctor run could not execute 12 of its checks — repo clone unreadable, scheduler unreadable, live site unreachable — and reported 20🟢/30🟡/1🔴. Re-run by hand at 20:35 from the same machine, with the same paths, everything resolved: 38🟢/11🟡/2🔴. The AUTOMATED run is systematically blinder than the manual one, which is the exact failure class OFFLINE_RESILIENCE was built to kill: the health report is produced when the operator is away and is least trustworthy precisely then.

P2.description: Four connected finance/research plugins (bigdata.com, Daloopa, LSEG, design) are used in ZERO places in the vault — largest under-used Claude capability.

The vault card 02_STOCKS/TEXMACO carries tv_symbol TEXMACO. Texmaco Rail & Engineering — the company the operator charted, whose earnings they flagged — trades on NSE as TEXRAIL. TEXMACO is a different listed entity (Texmaco Infrastructure & Holdings). Anything that ever prices or charts that card would fetch the wrong instrument. The 260801 read is banked under TEXRAIL; the card was deliberately NOT edited.

The vault's close pull and the cloud's price feed report different 06-Aug closes for three names, and a laptop publish overwrites the cloud's values with the vault's — so which number the desk shows depends on who wrote last, not on which is right
